task:
Napisz krótki tekst na anglojęzycznego bloga podróżniczego: **opisz miejsce w Polsce, które lubisz**.

- Gdzie jest i jak wygląda?
- Co można tam robić?
- Dlaczego warto je odwiedzić?

Użyj ciekawych przymiotników zamiast *nice* i *good*.
model:
My favourite place in Poland is Masuria, a region in the north-east of the country. It is famous for its lakes – there are more than two thousand of them! The landscape is peaceful and green, with thick forests, small villages and quiet roads.

In summer, Masuria is perfect for an active holiday. You can go sailing, kayaking or swimming, or you can rent a bike and ride along the lakes. In the evening, people often sit by a campfire and watch the sunset over the water.

I love this place because it is so calm and natural. If you need a break from the noise of the city, I really recommend it. Just don't forget your mosquito spray!
checklist: Piszę, gdzie jest to miejsce (in the north of..., near...).
Opisuję, jak wygląda, mocnymi przymiotnikami (peaceful, breathtaking...).
Piszę, co można tam robić (You can...).
Wyjaśniam, dlaczego warto przyjechać (I love it because... / I really recommend...).
